Glyphkeel is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify it under
the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by the Free
Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or (at your option)
any later version. The licence is in the file LICENSE that comes with
Glyphkeel.

Glyphkeel contains the third-party software listed below. Each part is
distributed under its own licence, whose text is in the last section.
Where a part is offered under a choice of licences, all of them are shown;
Glyphkeel uses it under one that is compatible with the GNU General Public
License. The source code of each part can be had from the addresses given.

This file is generated by `cargo xtask notices` from Cargo.lock,
pnpm-lock.yaml and licences.toml. Do not change it by hand.

3. Other components (6)
=======================

The Rust standard library
  Compiled into both programs.
  Licence: MIT OR Apache-2.0
  Source: https://github.com/rust-lang/rust
  Copyright: The Rust Project Developers
  Texts: [68], [16]

SQLite
  The database engine, compiled into both programs by the libsqlite3-sys
  crate.
  Licence: blessing
  Source: https://sqlite.org/

  The author disclaims copyright to this source code. In place of a legal
  notice, here is a blessing:

      May you do good and not evil.
      May you find forgiveness for yourself and forgive others.
      May you share freely, never taking more than you give.

KaTeX fonts
  The math fonts in the app's interface, which come with the katex package and
  are under its licence (listed with the JavaScript packages).
  Licence: MIT
  Source: https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX

TextMate grammars
  The grammars of code highlighting, which come with the @shikijs/langs
  package (listed with the JavaScript packages). Each grammar comes from its
  own project, under that project's licence; the list of grammars, their
  sources and licences is kept at the source address.
  Licence: MIT
  Source: https://github.com/shikijs/textmate-grammars-themes

NSIS
  The Windows installer and uninstaller are made with it and contain its code.
  Licence: Zlib
  Source: https://nsis.sourceforge.io/
  Copyright: Nullsoft and Contributors
  Texts: [342]

Microsoft Edge WebView2 bootstrapper
  Carried by the Windows installer, which runs it to install the web view when
  Windows lacks it.
  Licence: LicenseRef-Microsoft-WebView2
  Source: https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/

  A separate program by Microsoft Corporation, distributed under Microsoft's
  licence terms for the WebView2 Runtime. It is not part of Glyphkeel and is
  not covered by Glyphkeel's licence.
